body:
Hi team, I found the following SQL weird
```sql
memory D COPY (SELECT 'a;b' AS s) TO '/tmp/nl_repro.csv' (NEW_LINE ';', HEADER false);
memory D SELECT content FROM read_text('/tmp/nl_repro.csv');
┌─────────┐
│ content │
│ varchar │
├─────────┤
│ a;b;    │
└─────────┘
```
I think the reason is, in the current implementation we didn't quote the newliner character, which could be any character. The first character is considered, following the same convention of delimeter [here](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/50f9bb47fa2b7ad4ecd8b0d990ab7b1fd791c677/src/common/csv_writer.cpp#L40)
title: Quote CSV values that contain a custom NEW_LINE
